It threw itself on its stomach before the in-coming train. It was a close shave, we only got off by the skin of our teeth!”

arxiv-2011-09067.title: Distributed Injection-Locking in Analog Ising Machines to Solve Combinatorial Optimizations
arxiv-2011-09067.creator: M. Ali Vosoughi
arxiv-2011-09067.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by M. Ali Vosoughi. The oscillator-based Ising machine (OIM) is a network of coupled CMOS oscillators that solves combinatorial optimization problems. In this paper, the distribution of the injection-locking oscillations throughout the circuit is proposed to accelerate the phase-locking of the OIM. The implications of the proposed technique theoretically investigated and verified by extensive simulations in EDA tools with a 130 ​ n ​ m 130~nm PTM model.

arxiv-2105-00754.title: Magnetic angle evolution in accreting neutron stars 2021 Magnetic angle evolution in accreting neutron stars – A
arxiv-2105-00754.creator: Anton Biryukov, Pavel Abolmasov
arxiv-2105-00754.description: Abstract The rotation of a magnetised accreting neutron star (NS) in a binary system is described by its spin period and two angles: spin inclination α \alpha with respect to the orbital momentum and magnetic angle χ \chi between the spin and the magnetic moment.

arxiv-2109-13602.title: SafetyNet: Safe planning for real-world self-driving vehicles using machine-learned policies Thanks: Equal contribution. Thanks: Authors are with Toyota, Woven Planet, Level 5 self-driving division {matthew.vitelli, yan.chang, yawei.ye, maciej.wolczyk, blazej.osinski, moritz.niendorf, hugo.grimmett,
arxiv-2109-13602.creator: Matt Vitelli, Yan Chang, Yawei Ye, Maciej Wołczyk, Błażej Osiński, Moritz Niendorf, Hugo Grimmett, Qiangui Huang, Ashesh Jain, Peter Ondruska
arxiv-2109-13602.description: Abstract In this paper we present the first safe system for full control of self-driving vehicles trained from human demonstrations and deployed in challenging, real-world, urban environments. Current industry-standard solutions use rule-based systems for planning. Although they perform reasonably well in common scenarios, the engineering complexity renders this approach incompatible with human-level performance.

arxiv-2305-03726.title: Otter: A Multi-Modal Model with In-Context Instruction Tuning
arxiv-2305-03726.creator: Yuanhan Zhang, Liangyu Chen, Jinghao Wang Jingkang Yang, Ziwei Liu S-Lab, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore {libo0013, yuanhan002, lchen025, c190209, jingkang001, ziwei.liu}@ntu.edu.sg https://github.com/Luodian/Otter
arxiv-2305-03726.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant universal capabilities as few/zero-shot learners in various tasks due to their pre-training on vast amounts of text data, as exemplified by GPT-3, which boosted to InstrctGPT and ChatGPT, effectively following natural language instructions to accomplish real-world tasks.

arxiv-2307-03845.title: Error Analysis of an HDG Method with Impedance Traces for the Helmholtz Equation
arxiv-2307-03845.creator: Michael Leumüller, Scientific Computing, Austria, Joachim Schöberl, Scientific Computing, Austria
arxiv-2307-03845.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Michael Leumüller, Scientific Computing, Austria, Joachim Schöberl, Scientific Computing, Austria. In this work, a novel analysis of a hybrid discontinuous Galerkin method for the Helmholtz equation is presented. It uses wavenumber, mesh size and polynomial degree independent stabilisation parameters leading to impedance traces between elements. With analysis techniques based on projection operators unique discrete solvability without a resolution condition and optimal convergence rates with respect to the mesh size are proven.

arxiv-2309-15695.title: CONTEMPORARY COSMOLOGY FROM LAKATOS’ VIEWPOINT
arxiv-2309-15695.creator: J.E. Horvath (IAG-USP, São Paulo, Brazil)
arxiv-2309-15695.description: Abstract ABSTRACT: An analysis of contemporary Cosmology is presented, with the aim of identifying the elements present in it according to the scientific program structure created by I. Lakatos. We look at some modern controversies from this point of view and clarify the meaning of issues related to them within this context.

arxiv-2310-08534.title: Animating Street View Journal: TOG Conference: SIGGRAPH Asia 2023 Conference Papers; December 12–15, 2023; Sydney, NSW, Australia SIGGRAPH Asia 2023 Conference Papers (SA Conference Papers ’23), December 12–15, 2023, Sydney, NSW, Australia DOI: 10.1145/3610548.3618230 ISBN: 979-8-4007-0315-7/23/12 C

arxiv-2310-08534.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mengyi Shan, Brian Curless, Ira Kemelmacher-Shlizerman, Steve Seitz. We present a system that automatically brings street view imagery to life by populating it with naturally behaving, animated pedestrians and vehicles. Our approach is to remove existing people and vehicles from the input image, insert moving objects with proper scale, angle, motion and appearance, plan paths and traffic behavior, as well as render the scene with plausible occlusion and shadowing effects.

arxiv-2407-11878.title: Learning Confidence Bounds for Classification with Imbalanced Data
arxiv-2407-11878.creator: Matt Clifford, Jonathan Erskine, Alexander Hepburn, Raúl Santos-Rodríguez, Dario Garcia-Garcia
arxiv-2407-11878.description: Abstract Class imbalance poses a significant challenge in classification tasks, where traditional approaches often lead to biased models and unreliable predictions. Undersampling and oversampling techniques have been commonly employed to address this issue, yet they suffer from inherent limitations stemming from their simplistic approach such as loss of information and additional biases respectively.

arxiv-2412-12684.title: Strain engineering of magnetic anisotropy in the kagome magnet Fe 3 Sn 2
arxiv-2412-12684.creator: Deli Kong, András Kovács, Rafal E. Dunin-Borkowski, Michalis Charilaou, Markus Altthaler, Lilian Prodan, Vladimir Tsurkan, István Kézsmárki, Xiadong Han, Dennis Meier
arxiv-2412-12684.description: Abstract The ability to control magnetism with strain offers innovative pathways for the modulation of magnetic domain configurations and for the manipulation of magnetic states in materials on the nanoscale. Although the effect of strain on magnetic domains has been recognized since the early work of C. Kittel, detailed local observations have been elusive.

arxiv-2503-04477.title: Exact first passage time distribution for nonlinear chemical reaction networks II: monomolecular reactions and a A + B → C A+B\rightarrow C type of second-order reaction with arbitrary initial conditions
arxiv-2503-04477.creator: Changqian Rao, David Waxman, Wei Lin, Zhuoyi Song
arxiv-2503-04477.description: Abstract In biochemical reaction networks, the first passage time (FPT) of a reaction quantifies the time it takes for the reaction to first occur, from the initial state. While the mean FPT historically served as a summary metric, a far more comprehensive characterization of the dynamics of the network is contained within the complete FPT distribution.

arxiv-2507-03807.title: A note on finding long directed cycles above the minimum degree bound in 2-connected digraphs
arxiv-2507-03807.creator: Jadwiga Czyżewska, Marcin Pilipczuk
arxiv-2507-03807.description: Abstract For a directed graph G G , let mindeg ⁡ ( G ) \mathrm{mindeg}(G) be the minimum among in-degrees and out-degrees of all vertices of G G . It is easy to see that G G contains a directed cycle of length at least mindeg ⁡ ( G ) + 1 \mathrm{mindeg}(G)+1 .

arxiv-2510-16162.title: On periodic solutions of the Benjamin-Bona-Mahony-Burgers equation
arxiv-2510-16162.description: Abstract In this paper, we would establish the existence and stability of periodic solutions to the Benjamin-Bona-Mahony-Burgers (BBM-Burgers) equation in H 0 1 ​ ( [ 0 , 1 ] ) H^{1}_{0}([0,1]) , whose medium interior is applied with time-periodic force f ⁡ ( x , t ) f(x,t) with period θ \theta .

arxiv-2512-01968.title: Some remarks on L-equivalence for cubic fourfolds and hyper-Kähler manifolds
arxiv-2512-01968.creator: Simone Billi, Lucas Li Bassi
arxiv-2512-01968.description: Abstract We prove that if two very general cubic fourfolds are L-equivalent then they are isomorphic, and we observe that there exist special cubic fourfolds which are L-equivalent but not isomorphic. When the cubic fourfolds are very general in certain Hassett divisors, we prove that if they are L-equivalent then they are also Fourier-Mukai partners.

pmc-10616984.title: Lever-Test Accuracy in Detecting Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) Tears: A Single Institution Experience
pmc-10616984.creator: Mohammed Y Sarhan, Alaa Akel, Basel Balbisi, Yesar Faouri, Lama Alfraihat, Bashar I naser, Mohammad Abu-Jeyyab
pmc-10616984.description: BackgroundOne of the most often damaged ligaments in the knee is the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL). With the increased occurrence of ACL injuries, there is a greater need for clinical diagnostics to rule in or rule out a suspected rupture. The Lever Test, a novel clinical tool for diagnosing ACL rupture, has been presented, with preliminary trials indicating encouraging results.

pmc-12440648.title: The Diagnostic Value of the Random Urine Potassium‒Creatinine Ratio to the Synchronous Serum Potassium Concentration Squared for Renal Potassium Loss in Hypokalemia Patients
pmc-12440648.creator: Xinyi Wang, Fei Ding, Xinyi Huang, Yong He, Guixing Li
pmc-12440648.description: Background: Few parameters are available for diagnosing renal potassium loss in emergency patients or patients receiving treatment. This study aimed to investigate the ratio of random urine potassium‒creatinine to the synchronous serum potassium concentration squared ([UK/UCr]/SK2) and compare it with other parameters in the diagnostic ability of renal potassium loss.

pmc-12645274.title: Hidden assumptions of integer ratio analyses in bioacoustics and music
pmc-12645274.creator: Yannick Jadoul, Tommaso Tufarelli, Chloé Coissac, Marco Gamba, Andrea Ravignani
pmc-12645274.description: Rhythm is ubiquitous in human culture and in nature, but hard to capture in all its complexity. A key dimension of rhythm, integer ratio categories occur when the relationship between temporal intervals can be expressed as small‐integer ratios. Recent work has found integer ratio categories in most human musical cultures and some animal species' vocalizations or behavioral displays.

pmc-12812737.title: Effects of acute high-altitude exposure on heart rate variability: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12812737.creator: Hao Li, Xiangwei Chen, Cong Huang, Weiping Du
pmc-12812737.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to systematically review and meta-analyze the effects of acute high-altitude exposure on heart rate variability (HRV), in order to elucidate the adaptive changes of the autonomic nervous system under high-altitude environments.MethodsFollowing the PRISMA 2020 guidelines, PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Embase, China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI), and Wanfang databases were searched from inception to June 2025.

pmc-13039689.title: Narrative Dialogue Dataset: Speaker and Emotion Annotated Conversational Corpus
pmc-13039689.creator: Uzma Patil, Sejal Hanmante, Shivani Patil, Aniket K. Shahade
pmc-13039689.description: This paper presents a novel synthetic, automatically annotated dialogue-style dataset derived from narrative short stories, formatted as Speaker(Emotion): Dialogue. The corpus comprises 2,588 stories containing 27,074 dialogue utterances attributed to 2,582 unique characters, each annotated with one of six emotion categories (Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear, Disgust, Surprise).

pmc-13144916.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A2168 PROGRESSIVE LACUNAR STROKE AND THE EFFICACY AND SAFETY OF PROLONGED INTRAVENOUS THROMBOLYSIS
pmc-13144916.creator: David Cernik, Jarmila Neradova, Simona Vondrackova, Jan Bilik, Marta Vachova, Jan MacKo, Jiří Neumann
pmc-13144916.description: Background and aimsLacunar strokes are characterized by a high rate of progressive character and early recurrence. Therapeutic intervention is difficult, especially in the first hours after intravenous thrombolysis.MethodsAll consecutive patients who received intravenous thrombolysis (20 mg alteplase continuously for 10 hours) for progressive or early recurrence of ischemic stroke were included in the multicenter retrospective study.

pmc-13587298.title: Temporal deep learning for 28-day mortality prediction in critically ill ovarian cancer patients: a multicenter development and validation study using hourly vital signs
pmc-13587298.creator: Chengling Wang, Li Liu, Jianguo Hu, Xingshu Li, Xingchuan Li, Qikun Zhu, Liang Yang, Ke Pu, Renlan Li
pmc-13587298.description: BackgroundOvarian cancer patients requiring intensive care unit (ICU) admission face particularly grave prognosis, yet current prognostic models rely on static baseline characteristics and generic severity scores, neglecting the rich temporal dynamics of vital signs that may better capture physiological deterioration patterns.

pmc-13675485.title: Inhibitory Activity of Red Panda Islet Amyloid Polypeptide on Human IAPP Aggregation
pmc-13675485.creator: Lauren Phillips, Elizabeth L Moffet, Judah Mayfield, Eden L Jonick, Luiza A Nogaj, David A Moffet
pmc-13675485.description: Human islet amyloid polypeptide (hIAPP), a 37‐residue hormone co‐secreted with insulin from pancreatic β‐cells, undergoes self‐assembly into cytotoxic amyloid fibrils in the pathogenesis of type 2 diabetes (T2D). The resulting islet amyloid deposits are implicated in progressive β‐cell dysfunction and loss, making hIAPP aggregation an attractive therapeutic target.
